data.exact_reserve_text: The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of strengthening of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 7,637k (2022: release of GBP 87k). These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Closed Q2 2022 (effective 1 Oct 2021) providing $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves at the effective date; had a favourable impact on the prior year underwriting loss of GBP 9.3m (2022: favourable impact of GBP 44.6m) and reduced combined ratio.

Exposures (aviation reinsurance, credit/political risks, crisis management) reviewed; Aspen identified impacted policyholders and potential claims and examined received claims; reasonable provision made for identified claims though further claims possible.
Strengthening of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 7,637k (reported in the change in claims outstanding).

named_events.loss_description: Exposures identified; reasonable provision made for identified claims; further claims possible but not expected to be material for the Syndicate to date.
Exposures are being assessed following the ongoing conflict; not expected to be material for the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 1,267.1m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 77.1m (6.1% of opening reserves), i.e. an overall strengthening of reserves. Management commentary highlights influences including inflationary pressures (economic and social inflation), identified exposures from geopolitical events (notably Russia/Ukraine), and the impact of reinsurance arrangements including a Loss Portfolio Transfer with Enstar which provided material adverse development protection and produced a favourable cash/result impact in 2023. The syndicate notes a strengthening of net prior-year reserves of GBP 7.637m (net of reinsurance protection) during the year.
raw_causal_phrases: The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of strengthening of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 7,637k (2022: release of GBP 87k).
The Management Best Estimate includes an explicit uplift in respect of the potential impact of higher inflation on loss costs.
The Syndicate has assessed the impacts of both economic and social inflation on the reserve adequacy of the Syndicate's liabilities.
Exposures relating to the Russia and Ukraine conflict have been reviewed and Aspen has identified impacted policy holders and potential claims, and examined received claims.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims by underwriting year) by comparing each older underwriting year's current estimate with its previous diagonal and excluding the two most recent years (2022, 2023). The technical note that explicitly references prior year reserve movement reports a net (after reinsurance) strengthening of GBP 7.637m; that net figure differs from the gross PYD derived from the triangle (GBP 77.144m) due in part to reinsurance (including the LPT). No LOB-specific gross prior-year movement figures were disclosed; triangle is the primary gross source. The LPT and other reinsurance recoveries materially affect net movements and comparability.
